title: Scenario Kernel Execution Closure
description: Verdict that one scenario execution's recorded scenario-execution-observation.v1 trace fully accounts for the canonical execution vector: every step up to and including the one where the run stopped was observed exactly once, in canonical order, with no skipped, duplicated, or reordered step. Generated by tools/src/conformance/proof/execution-closure-mechanics.ts, never hand-authored — the same relationship scenario-kernel-execution-vector-projection-conformance.v1 has to its own observer. Does not itself prove lineage identity (executionId/rootExecutionId/parentExecutionId/scenarioId consistency) beyond the single execution it was computed for; comparing closure verdicts across a multi-execution trace (parent/child scenario chaining) is future scope, not built here.

expectedSteps.description: The canonical steps, in order, that a conforming trace for this execution's outcome must cover — a prefix of the full canonical execution vector when the run stopped early, the whole vector when it completed.

reason.description: Present when conforming is false: a short machine-checkable defect code, e.g. EXECUTION_LINEAGE_GAP (a canonical step was skipped or the trace stopped without a failure status), UNEXPECTED_STEP_ORDER, DUPLICATE_STEP_OBSERVATION, or LINEAGE_MISMATCH (executionId/rootExecutionId/parentExecutionId/scenarioId disagree across the trace).
